labels.ac: Enrichment: re-checks the final origin when safeFetch followed a redirect to a different origin
labels.desc: crawlCompanySite did not re-check robots.txt of the redirect destination origin after safeFetch followed a cross-origin redirect, and no test pinned it.

labels.ac: Robots fetches in enrichment use safeFetch(url, { maxRedirects: 5 }); redirects capped at 5 hops
labels.desc: The guard's robots fetch did not pass maxRedirects: 5 to the injected fetchImpl (safeFetch), so enrichment robots fetches kept the default cap of 3, below the specified 5.
